subject: Rattle on R 2.12.0 on MS/Windows - update

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Rattle on R 2.12.0 on MS/Windows - update
parts:
Rattle relies on the RGtk2 package for the user interface. RGtk2 is an interface to the GTK+ libraries (which is independent of R). The GTK+ installer seems to only be available for 32bit Windows from sourceforge.

The current situation is then that RGtk2 (and hence Rattle) works under Windows 7 32 bit (with the work around that zlib1.dll needs to be renamed or removed R's XML package's .../lib/i386 folder).

There are versions of GTK+ for Windows 7 64 bit but they don't seem to be packaged for distribution. GIMP, which is another package using GTK+ (in fact GTK+ was developed for GIMP) has a version for 64bit so it should be possible. I'll keep investigating but at present RGtk2 can not be loaded on the x64 version or R 2.12.0.

Rattle on 64bit GNU/Linux is not an issue - it has always worked there.

Regards,
Graham



On 11 November 2010 23:17, Richard Palmer <rhpa...@gmail.com> wrote:
Is this solution known to work on a 64 bit machine under windows 7 or should I be doing something different?  I will be glad to try it out:   however I don't want to waste my time if the solution is missing something obvious for the 65b/W7 configuration.

Regards,

if you have windows xp, and you need your rattle to work then install gtk-2.12.9-win32-2.exe

this will get you back up and running, until we can find a solution to the other issues.
